doc.summary: Configuration parameters used across multiple services.

params.csiBucket: (str) Name of an S3 bucket dedicated to Caber use for storage of objects shared between service modules
params.eventBucket: (str) Name of an S3 bucket dedicated to receive CloudTrail S3 data event log files.  This bucket must also have S3 Bucket Notifications that post to the SQS queue configured in 'S3_Scanner.inputQueue' for s3:ObjectCreated.  See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ways-to-add-notification-config-to-bucket.html
params.indexFile: (str) Name of temporary or default index files, without path prefix or suffix.  Defaults to 'index'
params.minObjSize: (int) Smallest customer object size in bytes Caber will not ignore.
params.reIndexSec: (int) Number of seconds after which we will force the reindexing of an object even if we discern that object has not changed since we last indexed it. Default: 86400 seconds (2 days)
params.reIndexGiveUpLimit: (int) Number of times to attemp indexing an object that initially could not be indexed.
params.objVersSeparator: (str) Character in CORI string user to separate object name and and object version ID
params.nullMsgSha256s: (dict[str]) Dictionary of {description: sha256} where the SHA256 values represent the hash of data sequences that contain nothing of interest.  For example, the SHA256 hash of a file that contains one null byte.
params.badMsgSha256s: (dict[str]) Same as nullMsgSha256s excpe the SHA256 values represent customer configured data sequences to igonore or redact.
params.remoteSuffix: (str) Suffix such as '.gz' to append to remote index files for transparent compression/decompression. See https://pypi.org/project/smart-open/.

dbTables.linkDataTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds output records from Link_Data
dbTables.objScanTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that contains records of which objects have been indexed and when.
dbTables.apiEventsTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds API request-response records from Process_API
dbTables.objEventsTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds Object access event records from S3_Scanner
dbTables.dataFlowTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds processed data flow records from Auth_Analyzer used to output the Sankey diagram on the dashboard
dbTables.authFailTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds authorization failure events from Auth_Analyzer used for reporting
dbTables.overlapTable: (str) (optional) Name of the database table that holds records of overlapping objects Auth_Analyzer used for reporting. Overlapping objects are two objects containing some number of matching byte sequences.
dbTables.wrkEventsTable: NOT IMPLEMENTED (str) (optional) Name of the database table that hold events related to scanning workloads

params.keepHashFiles: (bool) As part of the creation of per-object index files should an ordered list of the hashes inserted into the index file also be kept
params.setBoto3userAgent: (bool) If True all accesses to AWS resources will use each module's 'pathPrefix' as the user agent string.  This is to help identify accesses that each module makes.
params.hideCSIsvcs: (bool) If set to 'True' Caber Systems' services will be excluded from the graph
params.hideNames: (list[str]) If there are any other service names that should be excluded from the graph add them here.

authZoptions.summary: Options to configure how authorization is decided based upon user/service IDs and group membership vs. allow, deny, and region lists
authZoptions.uidPrefix: (str) Prefix for the record IDs in the 'identityMapTable'.  Default is 'USER-'. This covers users, service accounts, and other entity identifiers
authZoptions.uidIfNotFound: (str) Record ID to use for the null user, typically when a user is logging in and the API call is as-yet unauthenticated
authZoptions.allNoneTerms: (list[sr]) Lists of terms used in auth_tools.py module to check if an allow list, or deny list, has an 'everyone' or 'noone' entry.
authZoptions.uidSeparators: (str) or (list[str]) The UID string is a concatenation of authenticator, user_name, acceptor, user.from.host:  This list is the separators to use for joining the strings in the list.
authZoptions.allowSameUID: (bool) If true, consider a user/service authorized to access a data node if the user/service UID and data node owner ID are the same. If false, disable use of UIDs for authorization.
authZoptions.useAllowGroups: (bool) If true, consider a user/service authorized to access a data node if the user/service group membership(s) intersect with the groups in the data node's allow list.  If false, disable use of allow lists for authorization.
authZoptions.useDenyGroups: (bool) If true, consider a user/service authorized to access a data node if the user/service group membership(s) do not intersect with the groups in the data node's deny list.  If false, disable use of deny lists.
authZoptions.regionGroups: (bool) If true, the user/service's region must be in the same region-group as the data node's region the user/service is accessing for the access to be authorized. If false, disable use of region-groups. (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
authZoptions.defaultDatUID:
(str) What owner should be assumed for a data object whose owner-value is empty, i.e., ('', None, Null).
	Possible values are '' (leave owner empty), or any string value.  The UID cannot be a list.
authZoptions.defaultSvcUID:
(str) What owner should be assumed for a user/service whose owner-value is empty, i.e., ('', None, Null).
	Possible values are '' (leave owner empty), or any string value.  The UID cannot be a list.
authZoptions.defaultGroups:
(str) or (list[str]) What groups should be assumed for a user/service whose groups list is empty.
	Possible values are '' (leave an empty groups list empty), or any single group name (e.g., 'users') or list of group names
authZoptions.defaultAllow:
(str) or (list[str]) Defines the meaning of an empty allow groups list. By default set to 'all' = 'allow everyone'
	Possible values: 'all', 'none', or any single group name (e.g., 'users')
	If set to 'none' all access will be denied unless allowSameUID is True
authZoptions.defaultDeny:
(str) or (list[str]) Defines the meaning of an empty deny groups list. By default set to 'none' = 'deny no one'
	Possible values: 'all', 'none', or any single group name (e.g., 'users')
	If set to 'all' all access will be denied unless allowSameUID is True
authZoptions.firstOrMostOwner: (str) If multiple identity sources produce a result with different owner names, if set to 'first' pick the owner from the first and highest priority source (default). If set to 'majority', then the user name that appears most often is chosen.  If only two, then the first is chosen.
authZoptions.mergeAuthOption:
(str) How to join two identity dicts together when tow or more identity sources provide conflicting identities. There are three options:
          Priority ('priority' or 'first') (Default): Keep only the A.column from the highest priority source
          Complete ('complete' or 'most'): Keep the A. column that has the most total values in groups, allow, and deny
          Combine ('combine'): Combine the values in each of the groups, allow, and deny
authZoptions.authZColumns: (dict) Which columns in the dataframes stored by Process_API and S3_Scanner should be sent for identity lookup by type Service, API, Object and potentially User (although User and Service are currently the same). Oder matter.  the first column in the list will dominate.
authZoptions.nmersDecidingMargin: (float) If deciding authorization source between two objects A and B, and A has more nmers, but B was modified earlier, then multiply B's nmers by 1 + this parameter and check again.

params.credentialHmacKey: (str, secret) DEMO-ONLY VALUE. HMAC-SHA256 key that turns a credential with no directory owner into its principal key cred_hmac|<hex> (PyCaber spec 2026-10-12 section 8.2). Every service in a deployment must read the same value. The value below is a random string generated for the public demos; it protects nothing and must never be reused in a real deployment, which supplies its own secret (here, or as CSI_GLOBAL_CREDENTIAL_HMAC_KEY on every service).

doc.summary: [Keys and values will be populated at deployment time] Parameters on how to access and configure Caber dependent services. For each dependency there can be multiple configurations (targets).  Which target to use is specified by putting the target name in the useTarget key.

dependency_name.useTarget: One of the keys under 'target'.  Used to specify which target to use.
dependency_name.prefix: For shared-storage only: The CORI Prefix to use for Caber generated objects. Defaults to 'gss'

targets.doc: Dictionary of configurations for alterative targets for this service.  One target configuration must be specified.

target_name.doc: Name of the target configuration.  AWS services MUST include the suffix amazonaws.com. For example, s3.amazonaws.com, msk.amazonaws.com, rds.amazonaws.com, es.amazonaws.com, etc.
target_name.type: Name of the target type.  For example, with dependency 'message-queue' supported targets are 'sqs' for sqs.amazonaws.com, or 'elastic-mq' for https://hub.docker.com/r/softwaremill/elasticmq
target_name.url: URL to access the service.  Should contain scheme://host:port or scheme://accessKey:secretKey@host:port.  URL is optional if individual components of the URL are specified.
target_name.region: Needed to specify the region for certain AWS services
target_name.bootstrap.servers: Kafka-Zookeeper only: List of bootstrap server URLs

doc.summary: Configuration parameters for initializing the RKQCF module in every service.  Except for auto-resize and log2slots, index files created with different parameters are NOT compatible.

params.keyBits: (int) Number of bits to use for CQF keys.  8 <= keybits <= 64
params.valBits:
(int) Number of bits to use if inserting key:value pairs in CQF.  0 <= valbits <= (64 - keybits)
	For compatibility with Intersector value bits are currently ignored.
params.hashMode:
(int) CQF hash mode. Use QF_HASH_DEFAULT unless inserting key:value pairs. 0<= hashMode <=2 
	 0 = QF_HASH_DEFAULT 
	 1 = QF_HASH_INVERTIBLE 
	 2 = QF_HASH_NONE
params.autoResize: (bool) Enable/disable CQF index resizing during key insertion.  Disabling means you have set the number of slots to an absolute upper bound.
params.log2slots: (int) Default size of index file = 2^log2slots.  10-12 are reasonable values to set this to if auto resize is enabled.  Can be overridden at runtime
params.keyFunc:
(int) Determines transformation of nmers to keys. 
	 0: No transformation (key = nmer) 
	 1: Automatically insert nmer with sequence number (Key = nmer, value = sequence #) 
	 2: Linked mode Key(n)=nmer(n)|nmer(n+1)
params.topNmersLim: (int) How many of the most often inserted nmers to keep track of (NOT IMPLEMENTED - should this really be stored in the CQF?)
params.enterSha256nmers: (bool) If True (default) enter SHA256 hash bytes as nmers in the CQF (SHOULD BE FALSE)

doc.summary: caber-core is the single merged Rust ingest container (WS8 cutover). It replaces S3_Scanner, Kafka_Scanner, and Process_API: it ingests MinIO/S3 audit events over its built-in webhook, scans/indexes objects, runs the in-process document parser, and emits the legacy OpenSearch index set. This block carries the semantically-kept S3_Scanner keys VERBATIM (PyCaber crates/config CaberCoreModuleConfig reads them by the same names; unknown keys are ignored leniently). NER configuration lives in the top-level DocParser block, not here.

params.numIngestMessages: (int) Number of messages to grab and process at each cycle.  Must be greater than 0
params.metadataCache: (dict) Responses to head_object and bucket/object ACL+tag lookups are cached to avoid unnecessary lookups. 'timeTolive' sets seconds a response stays valid; 'maxItems' caps the cache size.
params.accumulateEvents: (dict) When accumulating individual event records to process them more efficiently, don't accumulate for longer than 'timeLimit' seconds and don't accumulate more than 'maxItems' before processing
params.indexIfNotFound: (bool) If true, try to index objects even if the initial head-object returned not-found
params.dropNoMatch: (bool) If true, drop events that match no configured object source
params.delete: (bool) Should CloudTrail event log files be deleted immediately after they are read. Should index for object be deleted when the object is deleted
params.objAuthZtags: (list[str]) List of S3 Object tag names/keys to be retrieved and used as part of object authorization policy
params.headObjectOptions: (dict) Extra options passed to head_object (e.g. ChecksumMode)
params.logLevel:
(str) Logging level for this module
	Allowed values: 'error', 'warning', 'info', 'debug', and 'verbose'

doc.summary: NER + parser-routing configuration read by caber-core (PyCaber crates/config: DocParserConfig registry entries for gliner/ontology; a dedicated typed loader arm for formatRouter, crates/config/src/loader.rs:317-353). formatRouter maps a document's content-typed MIME to a parser capability chain (crates/document_parser/client/src/router.rs). DEMO SCOPING (owner ruling 2026-08-03): the demo corpora are markdown-by-design, so the text/markdown, text/x-markdown, and text/* routes point at the markdown capability. The former application/octet-stream route and the demo-scoped defaultChain [markdown] override were ROLLED BACK: content_typer now sniffs markdown markers and generic text on hint-less bodies and finalizes text/markdown or text/plain instead of collapsing to application/octet-stream (PyCaber commit 4809c93d), so sha-named canonical bodies reach the text routes on their own. defaultChain is deliberately OMITTED so the shipped product default (defaultChain [docling]) applies; real deployments arm the docling sidecar via CSI_DOCLING_ENDPOINT. WARNING: the formatRouter block itself is parsed with deny_unknown_fields; never add doc/comment keys inside it, and defaultChain must not be present-but-empty (loader fails loud) -- omit the key entirely to inherit the shipped default.

Auth_Analyzer reads the output of Link_Data from Elasticsearch then (1) builds a representative graph in Neo4j, (2) calculates the combined auth policy for data nodes, and (3) analyzes the resulting graph for auth violations.

params.pathPrefix: (str) Mixed case string, no special characters, used to name S3 prefixes, logs, etc., from this module
params.repoName: (str) Lower-case string used for naming the docker repository for this service.
params.filePrefix: (str) Mixed-case 4 character string, no special characters. Used as the prefix for log entries and object names.
params.dependsOn: (list[str]) Which modules in GLOBAL.modules need to be running before this module.
params.logLevel:
(str) Logging level for this module
	Allowed values: 'error', 'warning', 'info', 'debug', and 'verbose' (enables detailed RKCQF logs)
params.remoteDebug: (bool) True to allow this module to call out to remote debugger
params.waitOnBuildNum: (int) On startup Link_Data resets it's build number to 0.  Each time it builds a new index it increments the number.  This value tells Auth_Analyzer to pause until the Link_Data index build gets above this number.
params.mergeHostService: (bool) FIXME If set to 'True' API host nodes and Service nodes that have identical names will be merged into one node in Neo4J with both Host and Service labels.  If false, they will be maintained as separate nodes.
params.inLinkCutoff:
(int) Determines what IN links to keep based upon how strong the link is (strength = to.nmers/from.nmers). If positive, quantile percentage at which to cutoff in links.  75 will leave only the top 25% of values. 
	If negative, will keep connections whose score is above abs(inLinkCutoff)
params.authfailMaxScore: (float) Sets the maximum threshold on path weight to alert if an authentication failure on the path is detected. Lower path weights mean stronger relationships between terminal nodes of the path.  Default 1000.
params.junkStDevs:
(dict) Standard deviations away from ave to consider an edge node Junk.  Two calculations are made so there are two values: 
'absolute' Look at the total number of IN relationships per edge.
'relative' Ratio of in relationships divided by the number of nmers the edge has.  The threshold on how high is determined by junkStDev, the multiplier of standard deviations from the mean number of IN relationships.  If junkStDevs is 1 then it is 1 standard deviation from the mean.
params.startRecs: (int) On start-up, the minimum number of Link_Data records that must exist in Elasticsearch before processing commences
params.incrRecs: (int) How many Link_Data records to read from Elasticsearch on each processing iteration
params.initNeoDB: (bool) If set to 'True' on start-up this module will erase and initialize the Neo4j database
params.splitAPIpath: (bool) If set to 'True' separate api nodes will be created for each level in the api path
params.splitOBJpath: (bool) If set to 'True' separate nodes will be created for each level/folder in the object path
params.checkAuthFail: (bool) If set to 'True' then check for authorization failures, otherwise don't
params.retrigger: (int) Number of seconds to pause between each processing iteration
params.connectUserDataAuth: (bool) If set to 'True' then connect the user identity to any data in an API request sent by a user and not seen before by the system.

doc.summary: Auth_Analyzer reads the output of Link_Data from Elasticsearch then (1) builds a representative graph in Neo4j, (2) calculates the combined auth policy for data nodes, and (3) analyzes the resulting graph for auth violations.

params.pathPrefix: (str) Mixed case string, no special characters, used to name S3 prefixes, logs, etc., from this module
params.repoName: (str) Lower-case string used for naming the docker repository for this service.
params.filePrefix: (str) Mixed-case 4 character string, no special characters. Used as the prefix for log entries and object names.
params.dependsOn: (list[str]) Which modules in GLOBAL.modules need to be running before this module.
params.logLevel:
(str) Logging level for this module
	Allowed values: 'error', 'warning', 'info', 'debug', and 'verbose' (enables detailed RKCQF logs)
params.remoteDebug: (bool) True to allow this module to call out to remote debugger
params.intersectorDir: (str) Directory path where to store Intersector indexes and associated files.
params.minNmerMatches: (int) Minimum number of nmers that must match between two or more objects. All matches below this number will be dropped.
params.dummyOption:
(int) How to handle deletion of dummy objects that hold unique intersections of nmers (aka, equivalence classes or 'edges' in Intersector).
	Option 1: Dummy dead if eqclass has only one non-dummy object and that non-dummy object belongs to no other eqclass.
	Option 2: Dummy dead if eqclass has only one non-dummy object but that non-dummy object may belong to other eqclasses.
	Option 3: Keep all dummies
params.maxHoldSec: (int) How long to keep local copies of object index files in seconds.  Set to 0 to disable deletion of CQF files.
params.maxRecs: (int) Maximum number of records from S3_Scanner and Process_API to read and process in each cycle. Default 250
params.minCQFnmers: (int) Minimum number of nmers/entries in each CFQ to be counted towards minBuildCQFs to trigger Intersector build. Now with region nodes producing mush smaller amounts of data per region we need to set this lower.  Default 1.
params.minBuildCQFs: (int) Minimum number of object CQFs needed to trigger Intersector build. Default 3
params.maxBuildCQFs: (int) Maximum number of object CQFs allowed in a Intersector build. Default 500
params.trgtRunLen: (int) DEPRECATED Used to set the target length of in-order sequence sets for matching (combiner.py)
params.useEQclassCategories: (bool) If True, use statistical categories [unique, ambiguous, junk] for scoring sequence set matches. Otherwise, treat all matches equally for scoring. NOTE: Used only when looking up sequence hashes in Intersector.
params.keepAboveScore: (int) Keep only sequence set matches with score above this value. Default 0 (keep all)
params.reTrigger: (int) Number of seconds to pause between run cycles
